name: so101_vial_to_rack_vision_mujoco_v0
description: SO-101 MuJoCo vial-to-rack benchmark for low-resolution wrist-camera pixel RL.
notes: Vision training is opt-in via the pixel actor-critic seed; existing state-based SO-101 vial-to-rack benchmarks are unchanged.
The policy input feed is the low-resolution wrist camera plus proprioception. The world feed is debug-only and appears in synchronized sampled trajectory artifacts.
